principles: TG may receive, hold and pay directly from both USD and AED company bank accounts. Native bank balances remain in the currency of the actual bank account.
USD to AED own-bank conversion uses the active Sell USD / Receive AED master rate unless the actual bank transaction proves a different rate.
AED to USD own-bank conversion uses the active Buy USD / Pay AED master rate unless the actual bank transaction proves a different rate.
Own-account USD/AED conversion has no fee by default. Record a fee only if the bank actually charges one.
TG financial year closes on 31 December.
For system final-accounts and tax presentation, TG is translated/presented in AED. This does not stop daily USD transactions or convert native USD bank balances into AED operational balances.

The Final Accounts / Tax conversion rate is separately effective-dated from operational buy/sell rates. Current management rate is AED 3.6700 per USD and may be changed later without rewriting historical transactions.
At closing, USD monetary balances are remeasured/translated to AED using the approved closing/tax master rate and the resulting accounting difference is separately traceable.
